objectives.text: Keep formal independence inside Italy's embrace. The 1939 Convention of Friendship and Good Neighbourhood, the EEC customs union of 1991 and the euro monetary agreement tie the state to Italy and the EU; survival as a sovereign micro-state depends on that framework holding.

The Association Agreement opens the financial sector only in phases and only after an assessment of the regulatory and supervisory framework, so the reforms needed to keep the sector are the ones that limit the secrecy it has traded on.

grand_strategy.reading: San Marino has no currency of its own and no independent trade policy, since the euro and the customs union bind it to Italian and EU rules. Its grand strategy is to keep the Italian and EU frameworks that guarantee its existence while turning its financial sector from a source of distinction into a regulated market. The Captains Regent speak for the state and the Secretariat carries the work. Its most important move, the Association Agreement, has been concluded but is not yet signed or ratified, so the reading of the 2026 steps stays provisional.

stances.note: Treaty alignment: the 1939 Convention of Friendship and Good Neighbourhood (signed 31 March 1939, in force 30 September 1939, per the search summary of the Italian sources). Bond kin: shared language and history. Structural friction (the 2009-2011 Guardia di Finanza and tax-haven disputes, the 2011 frontier-worker levy, the 2010 trespass incidents) is visible but does not make Italy a rival. Our reading, confidence B.

stances.note: Not a member, so partner is the correct grade for a non-member. The 1991 customs union is a treaty alignment and the euro monetary agreement is a second; the Association Agreement is the first step to single-market access. Trend warming: negotiations concluded December 2023, Council authorised signature 16 July 2026, signing scheduled 19 October 2026 in Brussels (not yet signed as of 2026-10-12). Bond none: pure interest.

stances.note: Aligned with EU sanctions since the 2022 invasion (the foreign ministry says San Marino had never sanctioned any state before). The Grand and General Council authorised the government on sanctions, reported as 1 March 2023 in the Wikipedia index (dates unverified in the Council records). No hostility beyond the sanctions; the Russian Unfriendly List entry is reported only by Wikipedia and is unverified. Neutral is the posture of a state that takes no side beyond its treaties; the trend is cooling because of the sanctions. Grade is our reading, confidence C.
